September 8, 1971
2014-12-12T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/september-8-1971-54681

Pak army, accompanied by Razakars, enters Raniganj Bazar. They kill 30 civilians and arson around 150 establishments including many shops.

A list of Pakistani representatives for UN General Assembly was published. The names are: Mahmud Ali, vice-president of Pakistan Democratic Party, Shah Azizur Rahman, Zulmat Ali Khan, Justice Jakir Uddin, Barister Kamal Faruki, Dr Begum Enayetullah, Ms Razia Fayez, Dr Fatima Sadik, Advocate AT Sadi, Advocate K Babar and few others.

General Yahya Khan loses his balance. Pak troops are fighting discreetly, they failed to advance according to their plans, says ‘Bangladesh’, an English weekly published from Mujibnagar.
